rationale: The workflow already implements the primary evidence-supported optimization (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE, dependency caching): it caches Bun dependencies keyed on bun.lockb and Rust/Cargo dependencies plus the src-tauri build target keyed on Cargo.lock, matching the measured cache-dependency pattern. The remaining candidate, P-LIT-FAIL-FAST (fail-fast: true), is contraindicated here because the matrix builds both arm64 and x86_64 macOS artifacts and every matrix outcome is required for the intended cross-platform build/test coverage; switching to fail-fast would cancel the remaining architecture job on failure and reduce coverage, which the task explicitly forbids. Other patterns (custom timeout, cancel-stale, test selection/prioritization) either lack representative duration history, would require new privileged/network actions, or would reduce required-check coverage. No supported optimization fits without weakening coverage or adding disallowed operations.
